name: OSN LP dividend weights not reduced on LP transfer
summary: OSN's _transfer set LP-dividend weight only on router adds and on removals, where it took the recipient's full pair-token balance, while plain LP transfers never cut the sender's weight. LP passed through addresses that each made a dust add and remove was counted many times, and the attacker collected the tax-funded USDT dividends.
notes: Reset is setStartTime (0x1956a767, block 37942319), the only later change on the path: startSwapTime defaults to 1e20, so every transfer between non-excluded accounts, including the anchor's router add and removal, reverted with 'not start' until it was set, which first made the path usable (rule 8). The start it set, 2024-04-18 07:13 UTC, passed 16 hours later; it also anchors the tax schedule, which changes only the loss size.
The anchor is a dust probe by 0x71940b72 that registered duplicate weight; the May campaign by 0x835b45 through 0x4a5acac3 realised the loss.

Loss is the USDT that the OSN/USDT pair 0x4eeddcc7 and the dividend tracker 0x8e474bc2 lost together, netted per transaction, in the fifteen transactions from 0xc7927a68: 188,808.80 USDT at DefiLlama's 1.001 and 1.00 USD. Each sell made the token swap its own OSN for the pair's USDT as dividends and burn as much OSN from the pair (burnPoolToken), so in ten of them the pair's OSN balance ended unchanged while its USDT fell; the 16,058 OSN it gained in the other five is not subtracted (rule 11). The attack contract passed 109,585.16 USDT to 0x835b45, which had funded it with 10, OSN's marketAddress 0xea1f5740 received 76,553.35 as its fee share and the flash lender 0x46cf1cf8 3,050.05 in fees. The anchor and 0xbf22eabb moved only 122.34 USDT of ordinary dividends from the tracker to other LP holders, which is no loss, and the 431.79 USDT that other users' transactions paid the attacker's helper addresses by block 38479509 fall outside the measured transactions.
